finding: A single task card listed `npm run validate:standard -- --json` as closure-required evidence, which promoted an all-repository release gate into every close attempt and made unrelated baseline failures block ATM-GOV-0245.
expectedBehavior: Task-card close validators should be focused semantic gates for the task. Whole-repo release health should be represented as a separate release/readiness card or advisory gate unless the task explicitly owns every failing surface.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0245 pre-close required `npm run validate:standard -- --json`; the standard run reached about 29.5 minutes with 55 passed, 13 failed, 18 pending, and 1 running validators before timeout/status inspection. The task closed only after replacing the validator with `node atm.mjs broker replay final-verdict --json` plus existing focused gates.
followUp: Add validator-tier guidance and import/pre-close diagnostics that flag release-wide validators in single-task cards, with an explicit task-card amendment path for replacing them with focused validators.
